Fiji Lymphatic Filariasis Sentinel Survey
This report generates a list of patients that have had a 'Lymphatic Filariasis Sentinel Survey' form completed. Each line in the report represents the completion of a single survey form. The report combines details from both the 'Lymphatic Filariasis Sentinel Survey' and 'Lymphatic Filariasis Sentinel Survey - Result' forms. Patients are listed in chronological order by date of 'Lymphatic Filariasis Sentinel Survey' form submission.
